Navigation keys not working in CAN monitor

Description

Right now, when using the CAN monitor, the down arrow key, page up, and page down keys don't work for navigating through the message display. Only the up arrow key works for navigation.

To reproduce:
1. Run the CAN monitor with a database file
2. Try to navigate through messages using arrow down key, page up key, or page down key
3. Notice that only the up arrow key responds, while the other navigation keys do nothing

This makes it difficult to browse through a large number of CAN messages, as you can only scroll up but not down or page through the data.
</issue>
